justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-modeled enum with distinct variants carrying relevant data (the offending char and out-of-range value), and the domain has no obvious further newtype opportunities.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinct variants, no panics or unwrap/expect in library code, and the saturating_add guards against overflow.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow surface (two functions plus error type), Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq derived, Display implemented, and every public item has a doc comment with crate-level docs as well.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses a static descending PAIRS table, matches!, iterator-style chars(), labeled continue, and clean borrowing without unnecessary clones — reads like experienced Rust.
